description: Direct income support scheme for farmer families, providing financial assistance in three equal installments per year to help meet agricultural and household needs.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three installments of Rs. 2,000 each directly to bank accounts.
application_process: Apply online via the PM-KISAN portal or through the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and land records.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must hold cultivable land in family's name; excludes institutional landholders and high-income taxpayers

description: Housing scheme offering subsidized home loan interest rates to help economically weaker sections, low-income, and middle-income groups own a home.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans, reducing effective EMI burden for eligible applicants.
application_process: Apply online through the PMAY official portal or via participating banks/lending institutions.

eligibility.income_requirement: EWS/LIG/MIG income categories as per government slabs
eligibility.other_conditions: Applicant or family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India

description: National health insurance scheme providing cashless hospitalization coverage, recently expanded to include all senior citizens aged 70 and above regardless of income.
benefits: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
application_process: Check eligibility and apply via the PM-JAY portal or nearest Ayushman Bharat empanelled hospital/CSC.

eligibility.age_requirement: All ages; automatic inclusion for citizens 70+
eligibility.income_requirement: SECC deprivation criteria for general beneficiaries; no income limit for 70+ category
eligibility.location: All states and UTs (state participation varies)
eligibility.other_conditions: Family must be listed under SECC database or qualify under the 70+ expansion

scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Rooftop solar scheme aiming to provide free electricity to households by subsidizing solar panel installation costs.
benefits: Up to 300 units of free electricity per month; subsidy of up to Rs. 78,000 depending on system capacity.
application_process: Register on the PM Surya Ghar portal, select a vendor, and apply for rooftop solar installation.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must own a residential rooftop suitable for solar installation

description: Micro-credit scheme designed to provide affordable working capital loans to urban street vendors affected by economic disruptions.
benefits: Collateral-free loans starting at Rs. 10,000, with higher loan tiers on timely repayment; interest subsidy on repayment.
application_process: Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal or via Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) with vendor certificate/ID.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must possess a Certificate of Vending or be identified in the ULB survey

description: Government-backed pension scheme targeted at workers in the unorganized sector, ensuring a fixed monthly pension after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after age 60, based on contribution amount.
application_process: Apply through participating banks or post offices with a linked savings account.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must have a savings bank account or post office savings account

description: Rural housing scheme aimed at providing pucca houses with basic amenities to households currently living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
benefits: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house with amenities such as toilet, LPG connection, and electricity.
application_process: Beneficiaries are identified via the Awaas+ survey; apply through the Gram Panchayat or PMAYG portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: Household should not already own a pucca house

description: Support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 identified trades, providing skill training, toolkits, and credit access.
benefits: Toolkit incentive, skill training stipend, and collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3 lakh in two tranches.
application_process: Register via the PM Vishwakarma portal or nearest Common Service Centre with proof of trade.

eligibility.occupation: Artisan/craftsperson in one of 18 identified trades
eligibility.other_conditions: Must be engaged in one of the specified trades (carpentry, blacksmithing, pottery, etc.)

description: Umbrella child protection and welfare scheme focusing on children in difficult circumstances, including orphans and children in conflict with the law.
benefits: Institutional and non-institutional care, foster care support, adoption facilitation, and welfare services for children in need.
application_process: Accessed through State Child Protection Societies and District Child Protection Units.

eligibility.other_conditions: Applicable to children in difficult circumstances, orphans, or those in conflict with law

description: Scheme providing LPG gas connections to women from below-poverty-line households, with an ongoing per-cylinder subsidy renewed for FY 2026-27.
benefits: Free LPG connection plus a subsidy of Rs. 300 per cylinder for eligible beneficiaries.
application_process: Apply through nearest LPG distributor with BPL/income certificate and Aadhaar.

eligibility.other_conditions: Applicant must be a woman from an eligible BPL household without an existing LPG connection

description: Newly launched scheme providing free cashless medical treatment to victims of road accidents, regardless of fault or insurance status.
benefits: Cashless medical treatment up to Rs. 1.5 lakh for road accident victims.
application_process: Treatment is provided automatically at network hospitals following a road accident; no prior application needed.

eligibility.other_conditions: Applicable to any victim of a road accident on Indian roads, launched 14 February 2026

description: Central scholarship scheme supporting OBC, EBC, and DNT category students for pre-matric and post-matric education, covering tuition and maintenance costs.
benefits: Up to Rs. 1,25,000 per year for post-matric students in premier institutions; lower amounts for other categories, paid directly to bank account.
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with caste certificate, income certificate, and admission proof.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must belong to OBC, EBC, or DNT category

description: Scholarship for girl students pursuing technical education (diploma or degree) in AICTE-approved institutions, aimed at reducing dropout rates among female students.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per year for tuition fees and other expenses, for the duration of the technical course.
application_process: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with admission proof from an AICTE-approved institution.

eligibility.education: Enrolled in AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree program
eligibility.other_conditions: Only one girl child per family eligible; maximum two girls per family across all AICTE scholarships

description: Scholarship to prevent dropout at the Class 8 to Class 12 stage and encourage economically weaker meritorious students to continue their education.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per year (Rs. 1,000 per month) for four years, from Class 9 to Class 12.
application_process: Apply through state education department after clearing the NMMS selection test conducted at the Class 8 level.

eligibility.education: Studying in a government, government-aided, or local body school
eligibility.other_conditions: Must clear the NMMS qualifying examination held in Class 8

description: Maternity benefit scheme providing partial wage compensation to pregnant and lactating women for the first living child, encouraging adequate nutrition and rest.
benefits: Rs. 5,000 in three installments for the first child, paid directly to the mother's bank account, linked to health checkups and vaccination milestones.
application_process: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or health facility with pregnancy registration and Aadhaar details.

eligibility.other_conditions: Applicable for the first living child; pregnancy must be registered with Anganwadi/health facility

description: Scheme providing assistive devices and aids such as wheelchairs, hearing aids, and artificial limbs to persons with disabilities to support their physical and economic independence.
benefits: Free assistive devices for those with monthly income up to Rs. 22,500; 50% subsidy for income between Rs. 22,501 and Rs. 30,000.
application_process: Apply through empanelled implementing agencies (NGOs, hospitals, district agencies) with UDID card and income certificate.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must hold a UDID card showing 40% or more disability

description: Scheme providing free assistive living devices to senior citizens belonging to BPL households, addressing age-related physical impairments.
benefits: Free devices such as walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids, and spectacles based on assessed need.
application_process: Apply through district-level assessment camps organized by ALIMCO with income and age proof.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must have an age-related disability or impairment assessed at the camp

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
description: Urban livelihoods scheme supporting the urban poor through skill training, self-employment loans, and support for street vendors and homeless shelters.
benefits: Bank loans up to Rs. 2 lakh for individual enterprises and Rs. 10 lakh for group enterprises, with interest subsidy.
application_process: Apply through the Urban Local Body (ULB) or City Livelihood Centre with proof of urban residency.

eligibility.income_requirement: Urban poor / below poverty line households
eligibility.occupation: Unemployed or informally employed urban resident
eligibility.other_conditions: Must be a resident of the urban local body area for a minimum period as specified

description: Scheme facilitating bank loans for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sectors, specifically for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
benefits: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for setting up a new enterprise.
application_process: Apply through the Stand-Up India portal or directly at bank branches with a business project report.

eligibility.other_conditions: At least one woman or SC/ST entrepreneur per bank branch; must be a greenfield (new) enterprise

scheme_name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Loan Scheme
description: Concessional loan scheme for persons with disabilities to pursue self-employment ventures, skill development, or higher education.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 25 lakh at concessional interest rates (typically 4-8%) depending on loan amount and purpose.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) with disability certificate and business/education plan.

eligibility.income_requirement: Varies by income slab (concession higher for lower income)
eligibility.education: No requirement for loans; academic enrollment required for education loans
eligibility.other_conditions: Must hold a valid disability certificate of 40% or more

description: Merit-based scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families to pursue college and university education, covering a wide range of undergraduate courses.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per year for undergraduate studies (first three years), increasing to Rs. 20,000 per year for postgraduate studies.
application_process: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) based on Class 12 board exam merit and admission to a recognized college.

eligibility.education: Scored above 80th percentile in Class 12 board exams
eligibility.other_conditions: Must not be receiving any other central government scholarship simultaneously

description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against yield loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases.
benefits: Insurance cover for notified crops at low farmer-paid premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial/horticulture crops).
application_process: Apply via bank, CSC, insurance company or the PMFBY portal before the cut-off date for the season.

eligibility.location: All states and UTs (state participation varies)
eligibility.other_conditions: Crop must be notified in the area; enrol before season cut-off

description: Credit facility giving farmers timely, low-cost short-term loans for cultivation and allied activities.
benefits: Revolving credit with interest subvention; effective interest as low as 4% on timely repayment for loans up to Rs. 3 lakh.
application_process: Apply at any commercial bank, RRB or cooperative bank with ID, land records and photographs.

eligibility.occupation: Farmer, tenant farmer, fisher, animal husbandry farmer

description: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Rs. 3,000 monthly pension after age 60.
application_process: Enrol at nearest CSC with Aadhaar, bank account and land records.

eligibility.income_requirement: Small and marginal farmers (up to 2 hectares)
eligibility.other_conditions: Monthly contribution Rs. 55-200 depending on entry age; not for EPFO/NPS/ESIC members

description: Provides farmers with soil nutrient status and crop-wise fertilizer recommendations.
benefits: Free soil testing and soil health card every cycle.
application_process: Contact the local agriculture department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra for soil sampling.

description: Improves irrigation coverage and water-use efficiency ("Per Drop More Crop").
benefits: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation and water-source creation.
application_process: Apply via state agriculture/horticulture department or the PMKSY portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: Subsidy rates vary by state and farmer category

description: Boosts domestic oilseed and oil palm production.
benefits: Seed, planting material and assistance for oilseed/oil palm farmers.
application_process: Apply through state agriculture department.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must cultivate oilseeds or oil palm

description: Financing for post-harvest management and community farming assets.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 2 crore with 3% interest subvention and credit guarantee.
application_process: Apply online at the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund portal via participating banks.

eligibility.other_conditions: Project must be for eligible post-harvest/farm-gate infrastructure

description: Develops the fisheries sector and supports fishers' livelihoods.
benefits: Subsidy of 40-60% on fish farming, boats, cold chain and related units.
application_process: Apply via state fisheries department or the PMMSY portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: Subsidy higher for women and SC/ST beneficiaries

description: Conserves and develops indigenous cattle breeds and boosts milk productivity.
benefits: Support for breed improvement, AI services and dairy units.
application_process: Apply through state livestock development board.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must own cattle or run dairy activity

description: Online trading platform linking mandis nationwide.
benefits: Better price discovery and access to buyers across states.
application_process: Register as a farmer on the e-NAM portal/app with Aadhaar and bank account.

description: Provides quality generic medicines at affordable prices.
benefits: Generic medicines at 50-90% lower than branded prices.
application_process: Visit nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra; pharmacists can apply to open a Kendra.

description: Promotes institutional delivery among pregnant women.
benefits: Cash incentive for delivery in a government/accredited health facility.
application_process: Register at ANM/ASHA or nearest government health centre.

eligibility.income_requirement: Primarily BPL / SC / ST (varies by state)
eligibility.other_conditions: Delivery in a recognised health facility

description: Free quality antenatal care on the 9th of every month.
benefits: Free check-ups and diagnostics by specialists for pregnant women.
application_process: Visit nearest government health facility on the 9th of each month.

scheme_name: National Programme for Health Care of Elderly
description: Provides dedicated health care for senior citizens.
benefits: Preventive, curative and rehabilitative services at government facilities.
application_process: Visit district hospital geriatric clinic.

description: Child health screening and early intervention for birth defects, diseases and developmental delays.
benefits: Free screening and treatment including surgery for children 0-18.
application_process: Screening done at Anganwadi/schools; referral to district centres.

eligibility.other_conditions: Free of cost at public facilities

description: Vaccination drive for children and pregnant women.
benefits: Free vaccines against preventable diseases.
application_process: Visit nearest anganwadi or government health centre.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandir)
description: Comprehensive primary health care near homes.
benefits: Free primary care, screening, medicines and diagnostics.
application_process: Visit nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir.

description: Financial help for BPL patients with life-threatening diseases.
benefits: One-time financial assistance for treatment in government hospitals.
application_process: Apply through the treating government hospital medical superintendent.

scheme_name: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme - Nikshay Poshan Yojana
description: Nutritional support to TB patients.
benefits: Rs. 500 per month through DBT during treatment.
application_process: Registered automatically when TB is notified at a government health facility.

eligibility.other_conditions: Must be a notified TB patient

description: Interest subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to about Rs. 2.67 lakh depending on income group.
application_process: Apply via bank/housing finance company.

eligibility.income_requirement: Up to Rs. 18 lakh annual household income
eligibility.other_conditions: No pucca house in family name

description: Single portal for central and state scholarships.
benefits: Scholarships from various ministries for school and college students.
application_process: Register and apply online on scholarships.gov.in.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Financial aid for SC students studying after Class 10.
benefits: Maintenance allowance plus tuition and compulsory fees.
application_process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 2.5 lakh per year
eligibility.other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste; studying post-matric

scheme_name: Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Supports minority community students.
benefits: Scholarship covering admission/tuition fees and maintenance allowance.
application_process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 1 lakh (pre-matric) / Rs. 2 lakh (post-matric)
eligibility.other_conditions: Min. 50% marks in previous exam; notified minority communities

description: Fellowship for top PhD researchers in science and technology.
benefits: Monthly fellowship plus research grant for up to five years.
application_process: Apply on the PMRF portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: Admission in IITs/IISc/NITs etc.; GATE/NET score requirement

description: Integrated school education programme from pre-school to Class 12.
benefits: Free books, uniforms, infrastructure, and inclusive education support.
application_process: Enrol in government school; implemented via state education department.

description: Free cooked meals for school children.
benefits: Hot cooked meal on school days.
application_process: Enrol in a government or aided school.

description: Residential schools for girls from disadvantaged groups.
benefits: Free residential schooling for upper primary girls.
application_process: Admission via local education office.

description: Collateral-free education loans for meritorious students.
benefits: Collateral-free loans and interest subvention for eligible students.
application_process: Apply on the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Interest subsidy for family income up to Rs. 8 lakh
eligibility.other_conditions: Admission to top-ranked higher education institutions

description: Improves child sex ratio and promotes girls' education.
benefits: Awareness, education support and welfare for girls.
application_process: Via district administration and Anganwadi centres.

description: Small savings scheme for girl child's education and marriage.
benefits: High interest rate (set quarterly, ~8%), tax benefits under 80C.
application_process: Open at any post office or authorised bank with birth certificate.

eligibility.other_conditions: Max two accounts per family (exceptions for twins/triplets)

description: Free skill training with certification.
benefits: Free short-term training, certification and placement support.
application_process: Register at a PMKVY training centre or Skill India portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: Indian national with Aadhaar and bank account

description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment to rural households.
benefits: 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year.
application_process: Apply for a job card at the Gram Panchayat.

eligibility.other_conditions: Adult members willing to do manual work

description: Collateral-free loans to micro and small businesses.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 20 lakh: Shishu (to Rs. 50,000), Kishor (to Rs. 5 lakh), Tarun (to Rs. 10 lakh), Tarun Plus.
application_process: Apply at any bank, NBFC or MFI, or on the Udyamimitra portal.

description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up micro enterprises.
benefits: Subsidy of 15-35% of project cost.
application_process: Apply online on the PMEGP e-portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: Min. Class 8 pass for projects above Rs. 10 lakh (manufacturing)

description: Financial support to early-stage startups.
benefits: Grants up to Rs. 20 lakh for proof of concept and up to Rs. 50 lakh convertible instruments.
application_process: Apply on Startup India portal via selected incubators.

eligibility.other_conditions: DPIIT-recognised startup incorporated within last 2 years

scheme_name: Employees' Provident Fund - Employment Linked Incentive
description: Incentive for new employees and employers.
benefits: Incentive paid on first-time EPFO enrolment.
application_process: Through EPFO UAN activation by employer.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Placement-linked skilling for rural youth.
benefits: Free training, boarding, certification and placement.
application_process: Register at DDU-GKY centre or via state rural development mission.

eligibility.other_conditions: Priority to SC/ST, women and minorities

description: Encourages apprenticeship training.
benefits: Stipend support to employers; apprentices get on-the-job training and stipend.
application_process: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal.

description: 12-month internship in top companies for youth.
benefits: Monthly stipend of Rs. 5,000 and one-time grant of Rs. 6,000.
application_process: Apply on the PM Internship portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 8 lakh
eligibility.other_conditions: Not full-time employed or in full-time education; no govt job in family

description: Financial inclusion programme for zero-balance accounts.
benefits: Zero-balance account, RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover and overdraft facility.
application_process: Open at any bank branch or Business Correspondent with KYC.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Low-cost life insurance.
benefits: Rs. 2 lakh life cover for annual premium of Rs. 436.
application_process: Enrol via bank/post office with auto-debit.

description: Low-cost accident insurance.
benefits: Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death/full disability, Rs. 1 lakh for partial; premium Rs. 20/year.
application_process: Enrol via bank/post office with auto-debit.

description: Pension for unorganised workers.
benefits: Rs. 3,000 monthly pension after age 60.
application_process: Enrol at CSC with Aadhaar and bank details.

eligibility.occupation: Unorganised worker (rickshaw puller, domestic worker, etc.)
eligibility.other_conditions: Not an EPFO/NPS/ESIC member or income tax payer

scheme_name: National Social Assistance Programme - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Pension for elderly poor.
benefits: Monthly pension (Centre Rs. 200-500; states add more).
application_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat/municipality or state social welfare department.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
description: Pension for widows from BPL families.
benefits: Monthly pension from Centre plus state top-up.
application_process: Apply via state social welfare department.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
description: Pension for persons with severe disabilities.
benefits: Monthly pension plus state top-up.
application_process: Apply via state social welfare department.

description: National database of unorganised workers.
benefits: Rs. 2 lakh accidental insurance cover and access to welfare schemes.
application_process: Register on the e-Shram portal or at CSC with Aadhaar.

description: Post office/bank deposit scheme for seniors.
benefits: Quarterly interest income with tax benefit under 80C.
application_process: Open at post office or authorised bank.

description: Long-term tax-saving savings scheme.
benefits: 15-year account with tax-free interest and 80C deduction.
application_process: Open at post office or bank.

description: Voluntary pension scheme.
benefits: Market-linked retirement corpus with annuity and tax benefits.
application_process: Open through eNPS or bank/POP.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana / National Food Security Act
description: Subsidised/free foodgrains for poor households.
benefits: 5 kg foodgrains per person per month free for priority households; 35 kg for AAY.
application_process: Apply for ration card with state food department.

description: Highest-subsidy food scheme for poorest households.
benefits: 35 kg foodgrain per household per month at nominal price.
application_process: Apply through state food and civil supplies department.

description: Allows ration portability anywhere in India.
benefits: Collect foodgrain from any fair price shop nationwide.
application_process: Use Aadhaar-seeded ration card at any FPS with e-PoS.

description: Rural road connectivity.
benefits: All-weather roads to unconnected habitations.
application_process: Implemented via state rural roads agency; citizens can raise demand via Panchayat.

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (Lakhpati Didi)
description: Self-help group programme for rural women.
benefits: Credit linkage, interest subvention and training for SHGs.
application_process: Join/form an SHG through local NRLM office.

description: Umbrella scheme for women safety and empowerment.
benefits: One Stop Centres, women helplines, shelter and support.
application_process: Contact One Stop Centre or helpline 181.

description: Nutrition and early education for children and mothers.
benefits: Supplementary nutrition, pre-school education and health services.
application_process: Register at local Anganwadi centre.

description: Support for children orphaned by COVID-19.
benefits: Education support, health insurance and corpus at 18/23 years.
application_process: Apply on the PM CARES portal via District Magistrate.

description: Shelter for women in difficult circumstances.
benefits: Food, shelter, counselling and legal aid.
application_process: Contact state women and child development department.

description: National ID for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Single document for availing benefits across schemes.
application_process: Apply on the UDID portal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
description: Development of SC-majority villages and skill support for SCs.
benefits: Infrastructure, skilling and income-generation grants.
application_process: Through state social welfare department.

scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
description: Funding for SC entrepreneurs.
benefits: Concessional finance for start-ups.
application_process: Apply through IFCI Venture Capital Funds.

description: Quality residential education for tribal children.
benefits: Free residential education from Class 6-12.
application_process: Admission via state tribal welfare department entrance.

description: Livelihood and market access for tribal communities.
benefits: Support for forest produce value chains and tribal enterprises.
application_process: Through state tribal welfare department / TRIFED.

scheme_name: Nai Udaan and Nai Roshni (Minority Schemes)
description: Support for minority women leadership and civil services aspirants.
benefits: Training and financial assistance.
application_process: Apply on respective ministry portals.

description: Solar pumps and grid-connected solar plants for farmers.
benefits: Subsidy of up to 60% (Centre+state) on solar pumps; farmers can earn from solar power.
application_process: Apply via state nodal agency / DISCOM.

description: Electricity connections to unelectrified households.
benefits: Free electricity connections for poor households.
application_process: Apply with local DISCOM.

description: Affordable energy-efficient LED bulbs.
benefits: LED bulbs at subsidised price.
application_process: Purchase via EESL/DISCOM distribution points.

description: Toilet construction support.
benefits: Incentive of Rs. 12,000 for building a household toilet.
application_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat.

description: Tap water to every rural household.
benefits: Functional household tap connection.
application_process: Through Gram Panchayat / state water department.

description: Digital access points for govt services.
benefits: Access to many e-services and banking at village level.
application_process: Apply to become a Village Level Entrepreneur on CSC portal.

scheme_name: Ladki Bahin Yojana (Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin)
description: Maharashtra monthly cash support for women.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1,500 directly to bank account (as notified).
application_process: Apply via Nari Shakti Doot app/portal or Anganwadi centre.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 2.5 lakh per year

description: Telangana women welfare guarantee.
benefits: Free bus travel for women in state RTC buses plus other benefits.
application_process: Apply through Praja Palana / state portal.

description: Investment support for Telangana farmers.
benefits: Per-acre per-season financial assistance (as notified).
application_process: Through Agriculture Department; land-linked beneficiaries.

description: Odisha farmer livelihood and income augmentation.
benefits: Financial assistance for cultivation, livelihood and insurance support.
application_process: Apply via Odisha agriculture department.

description: Odisha cash assistance for women.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 over five years (in instalments) for eligible women.
application_process: Apply at Mo Seba Kendra / Subhadra portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Not an income tax payer; state criteria
eligibility.other_conditions: Odisha resident; not in govt job

description: Monthly basic income for women heads of households.
benefits: Monthly assistance (higher for SC/ST) as notified.
application_process: Apply at Duare Sarkar camps / WB portal.

eligibility.other_conditions: WB resident with Swasthya Sathi card

description: Conditional cash transfer for girls' education.
benefits: Annual scholarship and one-time grant on completing education.
application_process: Apply via school/college on Kanyashree portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 1.2 lakh (with exceptions)

description: Monthly assistance to women heads of households.
benefits: Rs. 2,000 per month to head of household.
application_process: Register through Seva Sindhu portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Not income tax or GST payer

description: Free electricity for households.
benefits: Up to 200 units free per month.
application_process: Register on Seva Sindhu portal.

description: MP monthly assistance for women.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance (as notified).
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat / ward office.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 2.5 lakh per year

description: UP financial support for girl child.
benefits: Staged cash benefits from birth to graduation.
application_process: Apply on UP Kanya Sumangala portal.

eligibility.income_requirement: Family income up to Rs. 3 lakh per year
eligibility.other_conditions: UP resident; up to two children

description: Financial support for mothers sending children to school.
benefits: Annual cash assistance to mothers/guardians.
application_process: Through school and village/ward secretariat.

eligibility.other_conditions: Child in school with min. attendance

description: Bihar incentives for girls' education.
benefits: Staged cash incentives from birth to graduation.
application_process: Apply on state education portal.

description: Rajasthan health insurance.
benefits: Cashless treatment cover up to notified limit.
application_process: Register via Jan Aadhaar at empanelled hospital/e-Mitra.

scheme_name: Free Bus Travel for Women (Delhi - Pink Saheli)
